model_id: OpenAI Codex (GPT-6 family; exact serving revision unverified)

correctness_confidence.basis: At quotient correlation 1/4, j=3/5 and b=1/15 yield j-2b=7/15. The strict interval for ell permits both negligible shell moment and exponentially small exit. Pullback preserves the test-function quotient.

rigor.basis: The proof bounds all three parts of the potential and the edge tilt. Positive semidefiniteness supplies the sign of the centered covariance. In Theorem 4 the strict condition on s gives q>20 and hence the requisite multiplier integrability.

novelty.basis: The calibrated depression outside the typical set and small edge-law correction reach the exponent complementary to the cited positive criterion. Ordinary sphere return estimates are antecedents.

significance.basis: Settles the two-basis second-moment recovery question in the negative and identifies the strict threshold in the finite model. Equality and the optimal inverse exponent remain unresolved.

reproducibility.basis: Six-page exact PDF from identical Linux builds, explicit analytic proof and displayed probability estimates. The supercritical direction uses an external programme result. There is no machine-checked proof.

summary: The manuscript exhibits exponentially small gaps simultaneously with exact high-order marginals and exponential stationary Lp closeness to uniformity throughout the strict subcritical range. The above-threshold statement is attributed to a prior paper. The inverse-moment theorem is a separate sufficient condition. This is the first assessment of the identified bytes, in the research chat with manuscript involvement.
strengths: The variational gap witness lifts to the ambient chain exactly, including its variance.
N times the marginal error can be made exponentially small while retaining exponentially many Walsh constraints.
The inverse-moment proof gains a strict integrability margin without using an assumed pointwise density floor.
weaknesses: The positive side of the threshold requires the earlier working paper. Stable version links and source revisions for references 1–3 would improve reproducibility.
A single reference occupies page six. One overfull line is visible but all text remains legible.
The proof establishes existence with asymptotic slack and supplies no effective dimension bound.
potential_errors: The covariance lower bound would fail for a general reversible kernel without positive semidefiniteness. Lemma 3 assumes it, and Boolean noise with positive correlation has it.
The proof gives no strict slack at equality. The abstract and theorem avoid assigning equality to either regime.
strong_novelty_candidates: Two-basis examples arbitrarily close to uniform in the strict subcritical stationary norm with an exponentially small actual gap.
Exact matching by multiplicative tilt of the potential despite an exponentially small minimum density.
